title: Valid K-Unique Subarrays II
summary: Answer q inclusive-range queries. A range is valid when it has exactly k distinct values and all frequencies are even. Start with [l0,r0]. After each answer, set g=l+r if true, otherwise r-l; compute next endpoints (l XOR g)%n and (r XOR g)%n from the old endpoints, then sort the two endpoints. Return all Boolean answers. Later ranges may be singletons.
